'''Kōbe''' (こうべ, also read as こうど, ごうど, かんべ, かんど, じんこ, じんご, かのと)

== Overview ==
* [[Kōbe (Jinko)]] (かんべ/じんこ) - In [[:en:Ancient Japan|古代]] through the [[:en:Medieval period|中世]], a household associated with a specific {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=神社}} to support its rituals and operations.
* [[Kōbe (asteroid)]] (こうべ) - An asteroid.
* Place names ([[#Locations and municipalities]]).
''' Kōbe (こうべ) - Appears on [[:en:Japanese license plates|日本のナンバープレート]] as a designation for the {{ill|Kinki District Transport Bureau|ja|近畿運輸局|qid=Q11638662}}'s Kobe Transport Management Office in [[Higashinada Ward]], Kobe City, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo Prefecture}}.
* People and other uses ([[#People and other uses]]).

== Locations and Municipalities ==
* [[Kōbe Domain]] (かんべはん) - A domain in the {{ill|Suzuka District, Mie|de|Suzuka-gun|ja|鈴鹿郡|zh|鈴鹿郡|qid=Q278828|lt=Suzuka District}}, {{ill|Ise Province|en|Ise Province|qid=Q864166|lt=Ise Province}}. Governed by the {{ill|Q11590167|ja|神戸氏|qid=Q11590167}} and {{ill|Honda clan|de|Honda (Klan)|es|Clan Honda|fa|خاندان هوندا|fr|Clan Honda|it|Clan Honda|ja|本多氏|pt|Clã Honda|qid=Q2975272|lt=Honda Clan}}.
''' [[Kōbe Castle]] (かんべじょう) - The main castle of the Kōbe Domain in Ise Province.
* [[:en:Kōbe|Kōbe]] (こうべ) - A place name in {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo Prefecture}}, originating from the area being the shrine estate (Kōbe) of {{ill|Ikuta Shrine|de|Ikuta-Schrein|es|Santuario Ikuta|eu|Ikuta santutegia|fr|Ikuta-jinja|it|Santuario di Ikuta|ja|生田神社|simple|Ikuta Shrine|th|ศาลเจ้าอิกูตะ|zh|生田神社|qid=Q710086|lt=Ikuta Shrine}}.
''' [[:en:Kobe City|Kobe City]] - Located in Hyōgo Prefecture (こうべし).
''' [[:en:Kobe Port|Kobe Port]].
* [[Gōdo Town]] - Located in {{ill|Anpachi District, Gifu|en|Anpachi District, Gifu|qid=Q1204320|lt=Ampachi District}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|en|Gifu Prefecture|qid=Q131277|lt=Gifu Prefecture}} (ごうどちょう).
''' For other Gōdo Towns (historical municipalities and neighborhoods), see [[Gōdo Town (disambiguation)|Gōdo Town (曖昧さ回避)]].  
* [[Kobe Central Post Office]] - Located in {{ill|Chūō-ku, Kobe|en|Chūō-ku, Kobe|qid=Q686802|lt=Chūō-ku, Kobe}}.
* [[Kobe Post Office]] - There are four in Japan (as of May 1, 2008), pronounced as follows: "Kanbe" (千葉県館山市, 愛知県田原市), "Gōdo" (岐阜県安八郡神戸町), and "Kando" (鳥取県鳥取市).
* For {{ill|kambemura|ja|神戸村|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kobe Village|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11590158}} locations, refer to [[Kobe Village (disambiguation)|Kobe Village (曖昧さ回避)]].

=== Sports Teams ===
* {{ill|Vissel Kobe|en|Vissel Kobe|qid=Q844271|lt=Vissel Kobe}} - A professional soccer team in the [[:en:J-League|J-League]].
* [[Deuçon Kobe]] - A professional futsal team in the {{ill|F-League|en|F-League|qid=Q5423617|lt=F-League}}.
* {{ill|INAC Kobe Leonessa|en|INAC Kobe Leonessa|qid=Q2783054|lt=INAC Kobe Leonessa}} - A women's professional soccer team in the {{ill|Nadeshiko League|en|Nadeshiko League|qid=Q1628654|lt=Nadeshiko League}}.
* [[Kobe 9 Cruise]] - A professional baseball team in the [[Kansai Independent League (2009-2010)]].
* [[Kobe Suns]] - A successor baseball team in the Kansai Independent League (2011–2012).
* {{ill|Elecom Kobe Finies|en|Elecom Kobe Finies|qid=Q11291216|lt=Elecom Kobe Finies}} - A professional {{ill|American football|en|American football|qid=Q41323|lt=American football}} team in the [[:en:X-League|X-League]].

== People and Other Uses ==
* [[Kōbe Clan]] - A powerful family in Ise Province. {{ill|Oda Nobutaka|en|Oda Nobutaka|qid=Q2614349|lt=Oda Nobutaka}}, son of {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|en|Oda Nobunaga|qid=Q171411|lt=Oda Nobunaga}}, also adopted the name Kōbe.

=== Japanese Companies and Brands (with "Kobe" in the name) ===
* [[Kobe Bussan]] - A supermarket chain headquartered in [[Inami Town]], [[Kakogun]], Hyōgo Prefecture.
* [[Kobeya Bakery]] - A bread manufacturer based in [[Higashiyodogawa Ward]], Osaka. Also operates restaurants.
* [[Kobe Motomachi Doria]] - A restaurant chain under the [[Saint Marc Holdings]] group.
* [[Kobe Lamptei]] - A former fast-food chain specializing in gyūdon. Closed in 2017.
* {{ill|Kobe Steel|en|Kobe Steel|qid=Q1730802|lt=Kobe Steel}}.
* [[Kobe Bijin Nuka Honpo]] - A cosmetics company in Kobe, known for rice bran cosmetics.
